population_explanation: V2 metrics.json reports two evaluation scopes: 'all_model_eligible_unique_texts' (n=2005) and 'primary_domain_evaluation' (n=2004). The difference of exactly 1 record is source_record_index 14145 (combined_reduced.json:source_record_14145). In V2, this record has no accepted confident destination key (ambiguous bare domain without scheme) and was therefore excluded from the primary unseen-domain evaluation cohort, but retained in the all-eligible validation partition. In V3 experiments, all 2,005 validation representatives were evaluated together. All four models correctly classify this record as phishing (label=1).
